intro: Discover the art of self-healing and healing others through our 13 Days Ayurvedic Massages And Panchakarma Therapy (AMPT) course in the enchanting island of Bali, Indonesia. Ayurvedic massages stand apart from other massages by offering a holistic approach that aims to restore not only the physical body but the mental health, applying treatments for any specific concerns when needed.

Pancha, meaning five, and karmas, meaning actions, represent the ancient wisdom of Ayurvedic therapy that facilitates the removal of toxins from the body and enhances overall wellness. These actions include Vaman (emesis), Virechan (purgation), Basti (enema), Nasya (nasal instillation), and Raktamokshan (blood purification). Our course will equip you with a deep understanding of these practices, covering the fundamentals of Ayurveda and providing practical sessions on specific techniques.

issues: Page never names Ubud — it says only 'Bali, Indonesia'; location 'ubud' assigned by the site map, not page text.

Medical-procedure content (Vaman/emesis, Virechan/purgation, Basti/enema, Raktamokshan/blood purification) and 'removal of toxins' claim — review before publishing; page does not say which of these are practised hands-on (practical list covers Nasya and Vasti variants only).
No day-by-day plan; theory/practical topic lists only. Daily schedule has no afternoon session (unlike the 7-day massage course).
Spelling fixes in topic list: 'Pnachakarma' → 'Panchakarma', 'Mukha Ahyanga' → 'Mukha Abhyanga', 'Rekta Moksha' → 'Rakta Moksha'; 'Greva Vasti' left as published.
Certification wording inconsistent: 'Our Yoga Certifications' block names IYO and IYS®, while the inclusion line says 'International Yoga Organisation & Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society'.
Teacher block (Yogini Chiara, Yogini Shanti, Yogi Pandu) is the generic site-wide block; page does not state who teaches Ayurveda/Panchakarma.
Prices shown as struck-through original + offer (e.g. '1100 935 USD') with no discount label published.
Availability note says 'We offer the course throughout the year of 2025' — outdated year (captured 2026-10).
Page shows 'Shared Room' and 'Private Room' image headings, but 'Accommodation Type – Private' is the only accommodation stated.
Cross-sell blocks for other Bali courses and 'High-Demanded Healing Courses in Rishikesh, India' skipped.
